10k.note: Tenon Medical is a commercial-stage medical device company focused on sacroiliac (SI) joint fusion. The Catamaran SI Joint Fusion System received FDA 510(k) clearance in 2018 and was nationally launched October 2022. In August 2025 the Company acquired SiVantage / SIMPL Medical assets, including the SImmetry+ SI Joint Fusion System. No proprietary drug pipeline; revenue derived from device sales.

website.note: Company site describes Catamaran SI Joint Fusion System and the post-market MAINSAIL Study (33 patients, 6-month interim: 80% success, 61.6% pain reduction VAS, 43% ODI improvement). No drug pipeline page; pipeline path returns 404.

ctgov.note: Both registered studies are device studies (Phase: Not Applicable), excluded from P1/P2/P3 drug pipeline scope. NCT05628142 (Catamaran SI Joint Fusion CT Scan Study, Enrolling by invitation) and NCT05633888 (Post-Market Feasibility Study, Recruiting). Documented in commercial_product section.
